name: Velcrath: Survivors
description:
About This Game

Velcrath: Survivors is a dark-fantasy survivor roguelite for one to four players. Gather at a battered campfire, choose your survivor, and step into a world where the dead remain bound to unfinished work.


Your weapon attacks automatically. Staying alive is up to you. Weave through swelling crowds, read incoming attacks, and turn a closing circle into a path forward. Survive fifteen minutes of mounting pressure, then face the master waiting at the end of the road.


Choose from six survivors, each with a distinct weapon, passive and signature ability. Draft ranked traits as you level, and gather weapon upgrades in the field. Claim ability orbs, discover evolutions, and combine powers into a build that changes how you fight.


Take the road alone or invite up to three friends through Steam. Share experience and levels while each survivor builds their own arsenal. Stand beside a fallen ally to bring them back into the fight, and cover one another when the horde closes in. Every road and unlock can also be pursued solo.


Five cursed roads bring different enemies, hazards and bosses. Fight through their dangers in a world of worn stone, ember light and the bound dead.

Back at camp, put your salvage to work. Restore its stations, unlock permanent talents, forge weapon variants and chart your next route. More than a hundred quests open new abilities, items and talents. Weapon challenges offer new ways to arm each survivor, giving each journey a purpose beyond survival.
short_desc: Face the hordes alone or with up to three friends in a dark-fantasy survivor roguelite. Combine abilities and upgrades, survive fifteen minutes of rising chaos, and defeat the final boss. Return to camp, grow stronger, and forge your next run.
